examples.name: Appearance, shape, and size
examples.description: appearance sets how much attention it draws (default is outlined, primary has the brand fill, subtle has no border or fill until hover); round is a full circle at every size. The icon stays its default size at every button size.

examples.name: Loading
examples.description: Shows a Spinner in place of the icon at the same size, sets aria-busy, and ignores clicks. The button stays focusable and keeps its name.

examples.name: More actions menu trigger
examples.description: isExpanded sets aria-expanded to match whether the menu is open and keeps the hover fill while open. A "more actions" button uses MoreVertIcon, as Dropdown Menu and Table's row actions do.
examples.jsx:
const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

<IconButton aria-label="More actions" appearance="subtle" isExpanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}>
  <MoreVertIcon />
</IconButton>

examples.name: Named by visible text (aria-labelledby)
examples.description: Icon Button can't read the text aria-labelledby points to, so set tooltip yourself (or tooltip={false}).

antiExamples.name: Named only by tooltip
antiExamples.reason: tooltip describes the button only while it shows, so the button has no accessible name (and warns in development). Name the action in aria-label, which is both the name and the tooltip.

antiExamples.name: An icon the tooltip has to explain
antiExamples.reason: People have to hover to find out what an unfamiliar icon does. Use Button with a visible label (and the icon beside it if it helps).

antiExamples.name: Showing a state by switching the appearance
antiExamples.reason: Assistive technology can't hear an appearance change. Use Toggle Icon Button for something that stays on, so it's announced as pressed.

antiExamples.name: aria-labelledby with no tooltip set
antiExamples.reason: Icon Button doesn't infer tooltip text from aria-labelledby, so this shows no tooltip and warns in development. Set tooltip explicitly, or tooltip={false} when no tooltip is wanted.
